description: Source-derived classification of the payouts merchant edge. Distinguishes PUBLIC merchant routes from INTERNAL/ADMIN/WORKFLOW routes that share the /v1/payouts prefix, so kong-lite can expose only the public merchant slice (as a real Kong public edge does) and inject the upstream service credential (cred.API) only for the routes that need it. Derived by reading payouts/internal/routing/router/*.go in the approved corpus; see source_ref on each rule.

derivation.method: Every inbound route is registered as Route{group, middleware, endpoints}; class is taken from the group's middleware chain. Service BasicAuth(cred.API,...) is present on every group; a route is PUBLIC_MERCHANT only when the group ALSO layers PassportAuthentication that accepts a merchant (private/proxy/privilege) passport. Groups with service BasicAuth and NO passport (or admin-only passport) are INTERNAL_SERVICE / ADMIN_OPS and are NOT exposed on the merchant edge.
derivation.identity_resolution: auth/authHelper.go:13-25 GetMerchantIdFromContext: passport merchant id wins; the x-merchant-id / X-Entity-Id header is only a fallback used when the passport has no merchant consumer. kong-lite mints a passport with consumer.type=merchant, so for merchant callers the header cannot override identity. kong-lite additionally strips inbound x-merchant-id / X-Entity-Id so a merchant cannot supply identity headers at all.
notes: The false cross-tenant 'evidence' seen in Milestone 2 (fund_account_id fa_slitfa12345678, merchant_id 10000000000000, utr 528226169544) is NOT from monolith-stub. It is the payouts-api in-tree TiDB mock cannedTidbPayoutEntity() (payouts/internal/app/tidb/mock.go:59-85), enabled by [wda] mock=true (ENV2_COMPOSE/config/templates/base/payouts/arena.toml:824; declared-deviations.yaml wda.mock). It is reachable ONLY through GET /v1/payouts/fetch_multiple, an INTERNAL_SERVICE route. Removing fetch_multiple from the merchant edge makes that canned path unreachable by a merchant. The mock remains a declared low-fidelity deviation but is no longer merchant-reachable.

contacts / fund_accounts CRUD / balances-inbound / transactions / payout_links / payouts_batch are NOT_IMPLEMENTED as inbound routes in the payouts service (only /v1/fund_accounts/validations exists). kong-lite historically routed /v1/contacts and /v1/fund_accounts to payouts-api, where they 404. They are excluded from the public allowlist.

edge_behavior.default: deny (fail closed): a path that matches no PUBLIC rule returns 404 no_route, exactly as a real public edge that never registered the route.
edge_behavior.match_order: rules are evaluated top-to-bottom, first match wins; DENY literals are ordered before the generic public /:id param rule so e.g. GET /v1/payouts/fetch_multiple is denied before the GET /v1/payouts/{id} public catch.
edge_behavior.service_credential: cred.API service BasicAuth is injected ONLY for public routes whose upstream is payouts-api. It is never injected for the /v1/balances (xbalances) route, and is never applied to a denied path (denied paths are not proxied at all).
stripped_client_headers: x-passport-jwt-v1 (identity is minted by kong from the key)
preserved_client_headers: x-razorpay-account (legitimate sub-account header; forwarded so genuine authorization behaviour remains testable)
edge_behavior.activation: env KONG_ENFORCE_ROUTE_POLICY=1 activates this classifier. Default off = the frozen Twin v1.0 kong-lite behaviour (whole-prefix proxy), so the frozen verifier suite is behaviour-neutral unless activated.

public_merchant_allowlist.tenant_source: passport consumer.id (payout must belong to caller)
public_merchant_allowlist.expected_not_found: 404 / authorization failure for a non-owned or missing payout
public_merchant_allowlist.note: id restricted to the pout_ shape so internal literal subpaths (fetch_multiple, analytics, ...) do not fall through this param rule
distinct from the bulk PATCH /v1/payouts/attachments which is INTERNAL_SERVICE

public_merchant_allowlist.service_basicauth: none (xbalances has its own auth; cred.API NOT injected)
public_merchant_allowlist.source_ref: kong-lite/CONTRACT.md (x-balances is a real merchant read surface)

internal_denied.reason: service-cred-only group (BasicAuth 7-cred, no passport); not a merchant edge route
bulk / attachments internal group (svc cred + empty-passport)
bulk validate (proxy auth) — internal-app bulk surface, conservatively denied on the ordinary merchant edge (fail closed)

internal-app create entrypoint (privilege). Source places it in a passport group, but its semantics are internal-app; fail closed on the ordinary merchant edge (only POST /v1/payouts is the merchant create).

admin_denied.reason: admin passport group; never a merchant edge route

workflow_denied.reason: cred.Workflow/cred.API callback surface for the workflow engine, not a merchant route

not_implemented_as_inbound.note: no inbound contacts route in the payouts service (monolith-only). Denied on the edge.
not_implemented_as_inbound.source_ref: agent route audit: no group registers /v1/contacts

not_implemented_as_inbound.note: no fund_accounts CRUD in payouts (only /v1/fund_accounts/validations). Denied except the validations routes above.
